description: Work with your Planhat customer data: companies, end users, notes, tasks, licenses, issues, churn, opportunities and other records, send user activity and metrics, and start workflows when records are added or change.

planhat_company_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a company in Planhat is added or changed, such as its phase, owner or health. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.externalId: Its id in your own system
output.name: Its name
output.owner: The Planhat id of its owner
output.status: prospect, coming, customer, canceled or lost

planhat_enduser_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time an end user in Planhat is added or changed. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.externalId: Their id in your own system
output.name: Their full name

parameters.description: Only end users at this company. Leave blank for every company.
parameters.name: company_id

planhat_new_churn_trigger.description: Runs when a company's churn is recorded in Planhat, with when, why and the revenue lost. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only churn records at this company. Leave blank for every company.
parameters.name: company_id

planhat_new_company_trigger.description: Runs when a company is added to Planhat, with its status, owner and revenue. Companies already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.externalId: Its id in your own system
output.name: Its name
output.owner: The Planhat id of its owner
output.status: prospect, coming, customer, canceled or lost

planhat_new_conversation_trigger.description: Runs when a conversation (an email, call, meeting or note) is logged on a company in Planhat. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.subject: Its subject
output.type: Its type, such as note, email or call

parameters.description: Only conversations at this company. Leave blank for every company.
parameters.name: company_id

planhat_new_enduser_trigger.description: Runs when a contact (end user) is added to a company in Planhat. End users already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.externalId: Their id in your own system
output.name: Their full name

parameters.description: Only end users at this company. Leave blank for every company.
parameters.name: company_id

planhat_new_nps_response_trigger.description: Runs when someone answers an NPS survey, with their score and comment. Answers given before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only NPS responses at this company. Leave blank for every company.
parameters.name: company_id

planhat_new_task_trigger.description: Runs when a task is created in Planhat, by a person, a playbook or a rule. Tasks already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.dateDone: When it was done, if it was

output.startTime: When it starts or is due

parameters.description: Only tasks at this company. Leave blank for every company.
parameters.name: company_id

output.dateDone: When it was done, if it was
